title: 'get your bearings' inside the Kingswood's ridings routinely gave exact step-counts toward Hornhallow/Hunt's Stand (e.g. 'Hunt's Stand: 3 south and 3 east') but the rooms actually reached often lacked a matching exit in that direction, so the numbers read as straight-line distance rather than a walkable route — not wrong, but easy to take too literally when navigating.
